rule Suspicious_Chrome_Execution_From_User_Dir {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Chrome execution from user-writable directories, common in malware"
        author = "SOC Team"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    strings:
        $chrome_path = /\\Users\\[^\\]+\\AppData\\/ nocase
        $chrome_exec = "chrome.exe" fullword nocase
    condition:
        $chrome_path and $chrome_exec
}
